description: This file defines a Python class `APoTQuantizer` and associated functions for quantizing and dequantizing tensors using an APoT (Adaptive Piecewise Overlap Tree) quantization method, primarily for use in quantization experiments within the PyTorch framework.

classes.name: APoTQuantizer
classes.description: Class implementing APoT quantization and dequantization methods for tensors, including converting floating point tensors to APoT representation and vice versa.

methods.name: quantize(self, tensor2quantize: Tensor)

methods.description: Converts an APoT quantized tensor back to floating point representation.

methods.description: Performs a combined quantize and dequantize operation on a tensor to simulate reduced precision.
